name: Pre-College Programs (cost to you)
what_you_do: Live on or commute to the CMU campus for 3 to 6 weeks. Study architecture, art, design, drama or music. Also study computational biology or writing. You can also study culture. Pick the National High School Game Academy or college summer courses.
grades: 10th or 11th grade at time of application
who_can_apply: High school students at least 16 years old by June 26, 2027 who are in 10th or 11th grade when they apply.
pay_detail: The cost page, headed 2026, runs from about $6,209 (3-week music, commuter) to $15,202 (summer session, residential, 2 courses), plus a $75 application fee and an $800 enrollment deposit. Full scholarships for students with financial need.
duration: 3 to 6 weeks depending on the program (summer 2027 starts June 26)
deadline_text: Application opens December 1, 2026. Basic application (rolling admission) deadline March 1, 2027. Scholarship deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027).
how_to_apply: Apply online through the CMU Pre-College application portal starting December 1, 2026. The scholarship option is only considered under the February 1, 2027 deadline.
notes: The apply portal could not be read. Expensive; shown so families know the cost and the scholarship route. The three fully funded programs (AI Scholars, CS Scholars, SAMS) cost nothing.
